INSTRUCTION: FCVT.D.H
FORMAT: fcvt.d.h fd, fs1
RULE 1: Execution of FCVT.D.H MUST be supported only if the D extension is implemented.
RULE 2: When the D extension is present, FCVT.D.H MUST convert a half-precision floating-point operand to an equivalent double-precision floating-point result.
RULE 3: FCVT.D.H SHALL be defined analogously to the double-precision floating-point-to-floating-point conversion instructions, thereby inheriting their rounding-mode and exception-handling semantics.
RULE 4: FCVT.D.H MUST be implemented only when the D extension is present.
RULE 5: FCVT.D.H is a conversion instruction provided by the Zfhmin extension.
RULE 6: The FCVT.D.H instruction MUST be included in the Zhinxmin extension only when the Zdinx extension is present.
